Reveal each bar's value as the bar lands rather than only at the end of the beat, and keep Data's bounding box out of the bar-end and year-label zones (offset him to the right gutter or scale him down).

Constrain the mascot to the right gutter during the bar-race scenes (seg0–seg2) so row labels and bar tips are never covered, and give him a land-specific bit — e.g. shoving a bar backwards as the 2023 value slips.
Rescale the land-area bars against a non-zero baseline (or show delta bars) so 104M vs 129M vs the 2023 dip are visibly different lengths.

Hold the closing callout until the chart title has cleared the frame, or drop the title on the closing beat — never render both in the same band; and suppress the narration caption while 'COMMENT BELOW' is on screen.
Raise the crop-index chart into the empty upper third of seg3 so the frame's space is used.

Trim the bar tracks to the max value plus a small pad so the race fills the frame width instead of leaving grey gutters.
Reserve a caption safe-zone that excludes the chart body so subtitles stop landing on top of bars, the mascot, and the source credit.

Move bar value labels outside the bar (or to the track) once fill width exceeds the label width, so 74.4 / 54.2 / 44.4 / 40.9 read fully at seg1:end.

one_line: Real chart demonstrations and a mascot who actually performs, wrecked by a closing card that sits on top of the headline and a title-card hook that gives a scroller nothing in the first two seconds.
problems: hook@0.3–hook@2.2: the opening is a plain title card ('Agricultural irrigated land / BANGLADESH TOPS THE LIST') with five pinhead dots slowly inflating — a slow chart build, exactly the opening the rubric forbids; nothing happens for the first ~2s.
seg4:start–payoff@-0.4: closing callout overlays and truncates the chart headline ('...ut', then 'R'), its text spills past its own border, and it duplicates the source credit line at the bottom.
seg2 (seg2:start–seg2:end): the kicker reads '2005 PULLS AHEAD' while the bars plainly show 2005 as the SHORTEST (3.4) and 2021 the longest (16.7) — the label contradicts the picture.

seg2:start: bar values are hidden behind the mascot/empty until seg2:end, so for most of the beat the bars are unlabelled shapes.

fixes: Move the closing callout into the empty band between the axis labels and the source line, auto-shrink its text to fit inside the border, and never let it cover the chart headline; render the source strip once.
Animate the final 6s: have Data haul the 2021 endpoint up to 27.8 while a ghost marker holds at 19.3/19.7 so the 'two decades, barely moved' point is SHOWN, not just narrated.
Open on motion that belongs to the headline stat — e.g. the renewable line flatlining across the frame for two decades then the mascot stomping on it — instead of a title card with dots inflating.
Derive the bar-race kicker from the current leader ('2021 PULLS AHEAD') or drop it; never label the shortest bar as ahead.
Bind the highlighted number to the word being spoken so 'Bahrain' lights 40.9, not 54.2.
Show each bar's value on the bar from the moment it grows, and keep the mascot off the value labels.

problems: hook@0.3/hook@0.8: title-card opening over an empty field of five sub-pixel dots — no motion worth staying for, and the mascot is thumbnail-sized.
hook: narration says 'green energy took off' while the on-screen chart and title are 'Agricultural irrigated land' — the hook sells a stat that arrives 33s later.

seg1:start/seg1:end: burned-in captions ('farmland, Suriname 74.4,' / '44.4, and Bahrain') fall outside the card and across the red divider into the letterbox strip.

Re-cut the hook line to name the stat that is actually on screen at t=0 (irrigation), or reorder so the renewable-power scene opens the video and matches 'green energy'.
Fix the seg2 subtitle to describe the real trend ('2005 STARTS AT 3.4' or '2021 PULLS AHEAD') — it currently contradicts its own bars.
Move the closing callout to the lower third or fade the scene title before it lands so nothing overlaps in seg4/payoff.
Clamp caption baselines inside the card's safe area so seg1 lines stop bleeding over the divider.
Drop the duplicated aggregate source strip in the letterbox — keep the single per-scene credit.

one_line: Competent chart work with one genuinely good mascot bit at the end, but it opens on a plain title card over empty bars and spends its first 25 seconds on a dataset the title never mentions.

Give the first 2 seconds a physical beat: mascot shoving/stretching the US rail bar past China's, landing on the 148,553 vs 109,767 gap as the opening image.
Offset the mascot's anchor so he never overlaps the rank labels — park him right of the bar tip or above the plot, not on the label column.
Drop either the giant green numeral or the subtitle line during seg1:mid/seg2:start; one number treatment per beat.
Remove the unexplained cyan ellipse in seg1:mid and seg2:start, or bind it to the value it is meant to circle.
Move the closing card so it lands over the rail chart (or re-show the rail bars behind it) and stop it covering the chart title.

one_line: Three unrelated stats stapled together, ending on a methane chart while the closing line and CTA talk about railroads — and the mascot keeps standing in front of the labels he is supposed to be pointing at.

Add a mascot/label collision constraint — offset Data's x-position (or the bar's value label) whenever his bounding box overlaps a bar label or value, so seg1:end and seg2:end read at a glance.

Author a distinct per-beat performance for Data in every segment — riding the falling line in seg3, being buried by the growing rural bars in seg2 — instead of the shared idle stand pose
Format bar value labels with thousands separators (or abbreviate to '2.42B') so they match the narration
Reposition the closing bubble below the title or fade the title out before it appears; remove the duplicated off-axis '2.8' label

Cut total runtime toward 45–60s by dropping one bar-race segment and tightening the year-by-year recitations

Offset the mascot to the right gutter during the line-chart beats so the trend line is never occluded, and shrink/reposition the closing bubble below the title with a single source-credit line.

Replace seg1's bar race with a different device — an ocean-area fill/tile grid going from 6.8% to 17.5% shaded — so consecutive beats do not reuse the same chart form.
Open on the mascot physically hitting a ceiling (bar slams into a wall and stops) in the first 0.5s instead of a bar build, then run the race under it.
Move the closing speech bubble below the title or shrink it so the chart title, the 17 endpoint and the bubble each own their own space.
Show the 17.5% endpoint on the marine chart (extend to the 2025 value the caption cites) so the spoken number and the last bar agree.

Offset the mascot to a free margin per scene and give him a bit tied to the stat: in seg2 have him try to hold up the growing spending bar and get pushed back by it; in seg0/seg1 have him ride each shrinking bar down instead of standing beside it.

Demonstrate the tripling in seg2 - ghost the 2000 bar and stack three copies of it against 2018, or fill a jar three times, so the multiple is seen rather than stated.
